name: week
title: Product feed week
subtitle: Source freshness, stock exceptions and the work still owed

sections.title: Shops
sections.sql: select code,name,country,currency,owner from feed.shops order by code

sections.title: Source freshness
sections.sql: select shop,owner,products,stale_products,oldest_observation from feed.source_health order by shop
sections.note: Freshness follows each shop policy. An import date is not evidence of a fresh stock observation.

sections.title: Stock review
sections.sql: select shop,sku,title,availability,quantity,reason from feed.stock_watch order by shop,sku

sections.title: Open work
sections.sql: select shop,title,owner,due,overdue from feed.open_tasks order by due

sections.title: Release history
sections.sql: select channel,shop,counts,prepared_by,reviewed_by,created_at from feed.release_register order by created_at desc

sections.title: Ordered transformations
sections.sql: select c.name channel,r.priority,r.name,r.field,r.operator,r.match_value,r.action,r.target_field,r.value,r.enabled from feed.rules r join feed.channels c on c.id=r.channel_id order by c.name,r.priority
sections.note: Rules run in priority order. Exclusion stops processing that product. Prices and stock cannot be altered by a rule.
